aggregationPolicy.overallScore: mean of all planned run scores
aggregationPolicy.identityCapability: percentage of principal cases earning at least 16/20 identity points
aggregationPolicy.exactEvidenceRecovery: percentage of exact-source-eligible principal cases recovering at least one verified exact source without accepting its distractor
aggregationPolicy.evidenceAssociationCorrectness: correct source-to-case associations divided by all asserted associations
aggregationPolicy.similarSourceRejection: required distractors correctly rejected divided by all required distractors
aggregationPolicy.purposeInvarianceIdentityConsistency: anchors whose canonical identity key is unchanged across all four purposes divided by four
aggregationPolicy.actionPlanCompleteness: required action elements present divided by all required action elements
aggregationPolicy.confidenceCalibration: runs whose confidence falls within the frozen acceptable interval divided by all runs
